summary: Broadwind, Inc. via its subsidiary sold its Abilene, TX production facility to Freeman Enclosure Systems (IES Holdings) for up to $19.5M cash with customary adjustments. A short-term leaseback runs through September 5, 2026, plus a $500K equipment purchase option. $1M is held in escrow until vacating. Representations survive 90 days post-close or possession turnover. Watch for completion of vacating and escrow release; risk-arb focuses on asset transition and indemnity period.
